    difficulties = list(map(int, data[1:]))
    
    # Count the occurrences of each difficulty level
    difficulty_count = Counter(difficulties)
    
    # Sort the unique difficulties
    unique_difficulties = sorted(difficulty_count.keys())
    
    # Calculate prefix sums
    prefix_sum = [0] * (len(unique_difficulties) + 1)
    for i in range(len(unique_difficulties)):
        prefix_sum[i + 1] = prefix_sum[i] + difficulty_count[unique_difficulties[i]]
    
    # Find the number of valid K values

    for i in range(len(unique_difficulties)):
        # Number of problems with difficulty less than unique_difficulties[i]
        abc_count = prefix_sum[i]
        # Number of problems with difficulty greater than or equal to unique_difficulties[i]
        arc_count = N - abc_count
        if abc_count == arc_count:
            count += 1
    
    print(count)
